messages:
carla: quick heads-up — telemetry shows a spike in long-tail latency for llm-llama3q in eu-west this morning, not catastrophic but crossing our soft SLOs :chart_with_downwards_trend:
sre-oncall: noted. any correlation with runtime 3.1.2 rollout?
ben: looks like the canary for runtime-3.1.2 finished at 07:12 UTC, but only for small-batch traffic. eu-west had a different mix, so possible mismatch.
deploybot: Deploybot: Action required — model/runtime compatibility alert for model llm-llama3q on runtime 3.1.2 in region eu-west. Suggested mitigations: 1) temporary pin model to runtime 3.1.1, 2) enable safelist routing, 3) open rollback lane. Use `/deploy pin --model llm-llama3q --runtime 3.1.1 --until 2024-10-01` to pin.
dinesh: my vote is pin + safelist routing for eu-west only, then run a telemetry sweep for 2 hours. avoid global rollback unless we see error rates increase.
eva: ok to pin if we can automate rollback. also can we add a canary ratio change? shift 10% of eu-west to runtime 3.1.1 and keep 90% on 3.1.2 for 30m to validate.
carla: agreed. Ben can you coordinate deploybot pin and create the safelist? small checklist: 1) pin regionally, 2) update routing rules, 3) mark release notes, 4) notify infra.
ben: doing the pin now. Running:
```
/deploy pin --model llm-llama3q --runtime 3.1.1 --region eu-west --duration 48h --reason "soft-slo-latency-spike"
```
returning task id 981234. setting safelist rule to route existing registered customers with traffic < 2qps to 3.1.1.
sre-oncall: will watch metrics. can you also create an abbreviated rollback lane in case errors grow > 1.5x?
ben: created rollback lane and a backstop playbook — pinned in config and posted to runbook. deploybot confirmed pin and safelist update.
deploybot: Deploybot: Pin created (task 981234). Safelist rule applied to region eu-west. Rollback lane: /rollback lane create --id rb-8345 --scope eu-west --hold-to 3.1.1.
dinesh: nice. left a note for QA to run regression prompts for long sequence generation — please ping when telemetry shows stable.
eva: i'll run the eval suite now, focusing on longseq and KV cache behavior. will post diffs within 20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
carla: thanks. if QA passes and latency returns to baseline, we can plan a staged unpin tomorrow morning with a 1% step warmup every 10m. otherwise, escalate to rollback.
ben: tagging release notes draft under #release-notes: "Temporary regional pin to runtime 3.1.1 for llm-llama3q in eu-west while investigating long-tail latency regressions."
sre-oncall: telemetry after 30m: p95 decreased from 420ms -> 310ms for pinned cohort, overall region p95 improved ~12%. keeping watch for error spikes.
eva: evals running, no regression > 0.5% in sampling divergence so far. will update with examples.
dinesh: if things stay this way for 2h, propose we lift pin with phased unpin (1%->5%->25%->50%->100%) and monitor at each step.
carla: good plan. add automatic re-pin trigger if p95 increases > 20% during unpin window.
ben: added the trigger: `monitor.policy.add("llama3q-eu-west", metric="p95", window=10m, threshold=1.2, action="re-pin")`.
carla: ok closing this thread for coordination — keep updates in this thread and ping #oncall if it flips. thanks all.
